newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling falls amid IMF decision uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling falls amid IMF decision uncertainty.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling weakened sharply on Thursday before the International Monetary Fund (IMF) decides on future aid to the embattled east African nation.

The Central Bank of Kenya posted the shilling down 86 cents against the dollar at a mean commercial rate of 58.92 against 58.06 at Wednesday's close. The currency also took a severe beating from the pound, tumbling to 96.6 from 94.69.
